channel.description: This feed lists the most recent Official Public alerts in English for China Meteorological Administration

image.title: Latest Official Public alerts in English for China Meteorological Administration

item.title: Simao District Meteorological Observatory lifts the yellow lightning warning [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: At 01:51 on October 22, 2026, the Simao District Meteorological Observatory decomposed the yellow lightning warning signal issued at 19:52 on October 21, 2026.

item.title: Mojiang Hani Autonomous County Meteorological Observatory lifts yellow lightning warning [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: At 01:45 on October 22, 2026, Mojiang County Meteorological Observatory decomposed the yellow lightning warning signal issued at 19:45 on October 21, 2026.

item.title: Luchun County Meteorological Station issued an orange rainstorm warning [Level II/serious]
item.description: At 01:45 on October 22, 2026, the meteorological station of Luchun County upgraded and issued an orange warning signal of rainstorm: 42.8 mm precipitation has occurred at Hayu Station in Qimaba Township of Luchun County in the past hour; The rainstorm in our county will continue in the next three hours. The risk of rainstorm disaster in Daheishan, Pinghe, Dashuigou, Banpo, Qimaba, Sanmeng and other townships (towns) is high. Please prevent waterlogging, mountain torrents and geological disasters.

item.title: Mount Huangshan Meteorological Station issued a yellow fog warning [Level III/heavy]
item.description: At 01:43 on October 22, 2026, Mount Huangshan District Meteorological Station issued a yellow fog warning signal. In Taipinghu Town, Xinming Township, Xianyuan Town, Longmen Township, Yongfeng Township, Xinfeng Township, Xinhua Township, Gantang Town, Jiaocun Town, Tanjiaqiao Town, Wushi Town, Gengcheng Town, Tangkou Town, and Sankou Town, fog with visibility less than 500 meters may appear within 12 hours, or fog with visibility less than 500 meters but greater than or equal to 200 meters may already appear and continue.

item.title: Guangde Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for heavy fog [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: The Guangde Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog at 01:36 on October 22, 2026. Yangtan Town and Shijie Town in Guangde City may experience fog with visibility less than 500 meters within 12 hours. Please take precautions!

item.title: Pu an County Meteorological Observatory issues orange warning for heavy fog [Level II/Severe]
item.description: At 1:32 am on October 22, the Pu an County Meteorological Observatory issued an orange warning signal for heavy fog: it is expected that there will be heavy fog with visibility less than 200 meters in the high altitude areas of the central and southern parts of our county in the next 12 hours. Please pay attention to prevention.

item.title: Ningguo Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for heavy fog [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: The Ningguo Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog at 01:30 on October 22, 2026. At present, fog with visibility less than 500 meters has appeared in some towns and villages such as Zhongxi and Xiaxi in our city. Please take precautions.

item.title: Huidong County Meteorological Station issued a yellow rainstorm warning [Level III/heavy]
item.description: In the past three hours, the rainfall at the port of our county has exceeded 30 mm, and the precipitation is expected to continue. The meteorological station of Huidong County issued a yellow warning signal for rainstorm at 01:17 on October 22. Please pay attention to the prevention of urban and rural waterlogging, landslides and other disasters that may be caused by rainstorm. Huidong County Emergency Warning Information Release Center

item.title: Huoshan County Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for heavy fog [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: The Huoshan County Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog at 01:15 on October 22, 2026. At present, some roads in towns and villages such as Danjiamiao Town, Hengshan Town, and Yuerjie Town in our county have low visibility. It is expected that fog with visibility less than 500 meters and locally less than 200 meters may occur in the above-mentioned towns and surrounding areas within 12 hours. Please take precautions!

item.title: The meteorological station of Jiangcheng Hani and Yi Autonomous County issued an orange rainstorm warning [Level II/serious]
item.description: At 01:13 on October 22, 2026, Jiangcheng County Meteorological Station issued an orange rainstorm warning signal: 30.4mm precipitation has occurred at Tuka River Agricultural Station in Qushui Town, Jiangcheng County in the past hour; Heavy rainstorm will occur in our county in the next three hours. The risk of rainstorm disaster in Menglie, Kangping, Qushui, National Day, Jiahe and other townships (towns) is high. Please prevent waterlogging, mountain torrents and geological disasters.

item.title: The meteorological observatory in Simao District lifted the orange rainstorm warning [Level II/serious]
item.description: At 01:08, October 22, 2026, the meteorological station of Simao District will decompose the orange warning signal of rainstorm, please prevent the secondary disasters caused by the heavy rainstorm.

item.title: The meteorological station of Lvchun County issued a yellow rainstorm warning [Level III/heavy]
item.description: At 01:08 on October 22, 2026, the meteorological station of Luchun County issued a yellow warning signal of rainstorm: 32.7mm precipitation has occurred at the Twist and Straight Station in Dashuigou Township of Luchun County in the past hour; There will be rainstorm in our county in the next 6 hours. The risk of rainstorm disaster in Daxing, Daheishan, Pinghe, Dashuigou, Qimaba, Sanmeng and other townships (towns) is high. Please prevent possible waterlogging, mountain torrents and geological disasters.
